availability_policy.supported_report_date_basis: Versioned conservative replay support for retained 2024 annual evidence plus verified special/2026 schedules; ordinary historical reports use the seven-day conservative publication bound

noaa_gfs_weather_revision.purpose: PIT issued 00 UTC GFS 2-m-temperature forecast revisions for a mechanism-led Henry Hub response experiment
noaa_gfs_weather_revision.revision_definition: current eligible 00 UTC issued forecast minus immediately preceding eligible 00 UTC issued forecast for identical valid timestamps
noaa_gfs_weather_revision.market_decision_cutoff: 10:00 America/New_York on target trade date; actual source availability must be proven at or before cutoff
noaa_gfs_weather_revision.model_version_treatment: record NOAA implementation era; robustness stratum only; no outcome-driven era selection
noaa_gfs_weather_revision.content_identity: order/request manifest plus SHA-256 per GRIB2 file

availability_policy.basis: CME Henry Hub settlement closes at 14:30 America/New_York and the electronic trading day pauses at 17:00 America/New_York; 23:59 UTC on the trade date is later than both across U.S. DST and is used as a conservative historical availability bound

databento_henry_hub.purpose: canonical private-project CME NG official settlement/statistics and deep contract history for research and backtesting

availability_policy.basis: CME Henry Hub daily OHLCV is treated as available at 23:59 UTC on its trade date, the same conservative bound already validated for the canonical Henry Hub market path; this is later than the NYMEX settlement close and daily trading pause across U.S. DST

databento_henry_hub.approved_use_scope: private project research and backtesting of the already-purchased historical batch; no redistribution authority

noaa_observed_weather.purpose: observed-weather reconstruction and climatology source for descriptive Henry Hub literature reproductions and separately labeled modern robustness checks
noaa_observed_weather.product: GHCN-Daily observations plus NOAA station inventory/history/QC metadata with derived source-study climatologies; fixed 1991-2020 normals are robustness-only
noaa_observed_weather.snapshot_rule: Pin source version/date, station inventory/history metadata, selected station files, QC decisions, substitution lineage, derived climatology and content hashes before empirical execution; later NOAA revisions must not silently mutate a reproduction.
noaa_observed_weather.station_selection_rule: For Richman-Lamb-style Tier C reconstruction, form the literature target geography independently of outcomes; require at least 25 years of temperature history; rank candidate stations by completeness and available stability/move metadata; choose the nearest best-ranked primary and predeclare nearest reliable secondary/tertiary substitutions. Any unavailable original seed or move-history detail is recorded as a fidelity difference, not outcome-tuned.
noaa_observed_weather.missingness_policy: Honor NOAA quality flags; do not outcome-condition exclusions. Fill an eligible primary-station temperature gap only through the predeclared secondary/tertiary lineage; otherwise retain missing and report coverage.
noaa_observed_weather.climatology_rule: For source-study reconstruction, derive each calendar-day normal from the prior 30 years of bound observed temperature available under the fixed reconstruction rule. NOAA 1991-2020 Daily Climate Normals are a separate modern robustness layer only.

tier_a_exact_original.description: Recovered original Richman-Lamb or source-study weather artifact, hash-pinned and used without silent substitution.

tier_b_algorithmic_richman_lamb.description: Algorithmic Richman-Lamb regeneration using recovered original seed/station metadata and documented substitution/QC lineage.

tier_c_noaa_near_reconstruction.description: NOAA GHCN-Daily near reconstruction using the documented station-screen/selection/substitution logic and explicit fidelity differences where original seed or move metadata is unavailable.
tier_c_noaa_near_reconstruction.climatology: rolling prior-30-year day-of-year climatology from the bound observed-temperature history

tier_d_modern_normals_robustness.description: Modern robustness only; fixed current GHCN-Daily station construction plus NOAA 1991-2020 normals. Never label this tier source-faithful to Mu or Ergen/Rizvanoghlu.

noaa_observed_weather.availability_semantics: Observed-weather explanatory reproduction only. Do not reuse as issued-forecast or trading-at-origin evidence. Fidelity tier must be carried into every derived artifact.

source_library.purpose: Preserve the broader candidate-source and desired-dataset knowledge used to plan Commodity research. This library is the first stop for source discovery; current provider implementation, operational status, PIT admissibility, licensing approval, acquisition authority and backtest eligibility remain owned by providers/sources and their explicit evidence gates.

recovered_from.recovery_basis: last rich maintained Natural Gas Data Manifest before generated-document simplification

authority_boundary.promotion_rule: A library candidate becomes an operational source only through an explicit provider/source entry with verified semantics, PIT/revision handling, provenance, access/licensing and applicable research evidence gates.

data_contract_rules: Preserve observed_for, published_at or issued_at, available_at, retrieved_at, source identity/version, units and revision state whenever the source supports them.
Backtests may use a value only after available_at; revised or final history must not replace the value knowable at prediction time.
Derived features are reproducible transformations rather than new sources; retain and version raw source values.
A current-state historical snapshot is not PIT backtest evidence unless historical publication/revision availability is reconstructed.

primary_contract_history.pit_access_note: Use exact listed-contract identity and never compute returns across contract rolls; current approved market-source state remains in sources.

issued_weather_forecasts.ideal_datapoints: issue/available/valid time, lead, 2m temperature, HDD/CDD, wind, humidity, precipitation/snow, forecast revisions, demand-region anchors
issued_weather_forecasts.preferred_sources: Open-Meteo issued-run archives; NOAA GFS/GEFS; ECMWF archive where approved
issued_weather_forecasts.pit_access_note: Use actually-issued vintages only; never substitute reanalysis. Preserve run identity and source availability.

underground_storage.ideal_datapoints: Lower-48 working gas, weekly change, release/revision event identity and PIT state
underground_storage.preferred_sources: EIA WNGSR ngshistory.xls plus revisions.xls; API v2/bulk for screening
underground_storage.pit_access_note: Reconstruct first-public values, later revisions, holiday releases and special revision events rather than backfilling corrected history.

gas_production_and_balance.ideal_datapoints: dry, marketed and gross production; state/region; supply/disposition; offshore production
gas_production_and_balance.pit_access_note: Apply actual publication lag and reconstruct historical revisions before backtest use.

gas_demand_and_power_burn.preferred_sources: EIA Natural Gas; archived issued ISO load forecasts; EIA-930 screening

discovered_after_recovery.rule: These are source-hunt findings added after recovery of the historical manifest. They remain discovery evidence and do not promote a source into operational or empirical authority.

historical_storage_consensus.preferred_route: Bloomberg weekly natural-gas storage analyst consensus
independent_routes: S&P Global / Platts weekly analyst storage survey
historical_storage_consensus.reason: Chiou-Wei, Linn and Zhu explicitly use the weekly Bloomberg consensus analyst forecast as their expectation proxy, and Gay, Simkins and Turac construct their analyst database from Bloomberg surveys. Bloomberg therefore outranks Platts for source-faithful reproduction. Platts is an independent analyst-survey route; Estimize is a distinct forecaster population and cannot silently substitute for the published construct.

friday_attention_exact_data.reason: Gu, Kurov and Stan state that their study data are available from Genesis Financial Technologies and Bloomberg and require subscription fees. Repository Databento plus independently sourced storage consensus can support only a separately labeled near replication unless the paper's exact data are licensed.

liang_weather_volatility_inputs.preferred_route: source-study historical weather variables for New York and Louisiana
liang_weather_volatility_inputs.reason: Liang et al. use EIA Henry Hub 1-month futures from January 1995 to July 2021 and historical wind speed, temperature and precipitation variables, with New York and Louisiana reported in robustness tables. This is not an issued-weather-forecast-vintage design. The exact weather provider/source identity still needs verification before source-faithful replication.

real_time_monthly_fundamental_vintages.preferred_route: Baumeister-Huber-Lee-Ravazzolo JAE open data archive plus replication code
real_time_monthly_fundamental_vintages.reason: The authors publish the real-time database used by the paper, with vintages from 1991 and data back to 1973 where available. EIA STEO archives remain an independent reconstruction route and include release dates plus monthly Excel files from later years; correction notices require explicit revision handling.

crude_oil_benchmark.preferred_route: EIA WTI spot and EIA crude-oil futures rank histories
crude_oil_benchmark.reason: EIA publishes deep WTI spot history and fixed-rank futures histories; exact literature benchmark semantics still need to be matched before execution.

european_gas_benchmark_and_structural_co.preferred_route: Rubaszek-Szafranek author-linked RepOD replication package for first reproduction
european_gas_benchmark_and_structural_co.independent_route: ICE TTF plus ENTSOG/GIE physical controls
european_gas_benchmark_and_structural_co.reason: The target paper has author-linked replication files. For later independent reconstruction, ENTSOG and GIE expose public APIs, while official ICE TTF historical market data is an entitlement/licensing decision.

lng_capacity_and_feedgas.preferred_route: terminal-linked pipeline informational postings / scheduled quantities
lng_capacity_and_feedgas.reason: Operator postings expose scheduled quantities/capacity at named LNG delivery points (for example Gulf Run to Golden Pass). A complete Henry Hub study requires terminal-pipeline mapping, historical depth, posting-time semantics and coverage across export terminals before promotion.

macro_real_time_vintages.reason: The St. Louis Fed API supports vintage_dates and real-time periods for historical values; source release dates are distinct from FRED availability and must be treated accordingly.

observed_weather_reproduction.preferred_route: NOAA GHCN-Daily observations plus U.S. Daily Climate Normals 1991-2020
observed_weather_reproduction.reason: The retained Open-Meteo archive is issued-forecast data. NOAA GHCN-Daily supplies quality-controlled historical daily observations and the official daily normals supply fixed temperature/HDD/CDD climatology for descriptive mechanism replication.

acquisition_order: Use already-preserved authoritative market corpora through validated adapters before buying replacement history; verify licensing and source semantics before promotion.
Treat existing leakage-safe evidence datasets as baselines; justify new infrastructure by a measured data/model gap or a preregistered hypothesis.
Close PIT gaps only when they materially constrain a selected experiment, especially historical revisions, publication vintages and issued-weather coverage.
Add Global/Interconnect and Norway/Europe inputs through the same reusable evidence interfaces only when a Henry Hub hypothesis requires their incremental information.
For additional instruments, perform feasibility screening and use instrument/data adapters before purchasing expensive instrument-specific sources.
Treat TTF, JKM and other targets as independent empirical programmes; Henry Hub findings do not transfer automatically.
Add Later sources only when literature, ablation evidence or a preregistered mechanism justifies acquisition/licensing cost.
